semantics: Pure combinational two-input NOR: out = ~(in1 | in2).
numeric_widths: All ports and gate operations are one-bit unsigned logic. No arithmetic.
latency_reset_behavior: Zero cycle combinational latency; no clock, reset or state.
verification_plan: Explicit dev_tb top, exhaustive binary truth table: 00 -> 1, 01 -> 0, 10 -> 0, 11 -> 0. Case-inequality rejects unknown output.
